thread:
Ravi: Quick brainstorm — we want a lightweight pricing slab with a 'commitment slider' on the page. Idea: user drags slider to choose monthly commit and sees instant unit price + estimated spend. Primary goals: (1) surface enterprise-shaped leads, (2) make self-serve conversion seamless, (3) tie webinar enrollment to mid-tier interest. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sora: Nice. Two routing rules I'd run: auto-tag as "sdr-hot" if commit >= $6k OR they toggle 'Request Contract'. Otherwise send to nurture sequence and optionally auto-enroll in next open webinar.
Kayla: UX: Let's keep slider min $0, max $25k, with ticks at 250, 1k, 5k, 10k. When user releases the handle at >=5k show a subtle banner: "Request a custom SLA" with CTA 'Get matched'. For <5k show 'Start free trial'.
Ben: Metric POV 10% of visitors touching the slider is a good benchmark. For conversion, we should track slider_interact -> slider_commit_value -> click_primary_cta. Sample GTM push: ```js
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
function pushPricingSlider(val, plan){
  window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'pricing_slider', slider_value_usd: val, suggested_plan: plan });
}
```
Tao: Copy suggestions for micro-FAQ on the widget (one liners):
- "How accurate is this estimate?" 10 — It's a usage-based estimate; real billing may vary based on actual token mix.
- "What happens if I undercommit?" 10 — You can scale up; Dedicated reservations available for predictable throughput.
- "Can I try before committing?" 10 — Yes. Trials and hourly usage available.
Ravi: Tier naming experiment — want non-generic but clear. Drafts: Option A: ["Flux", "Ramp", "Beacon"]; Option B: ["Forge", "Vector", "Citadel"]. My leaning is Flux/Ramp/Beacon — lighter and product-forward.
Kayla: Flux/Ramp/Beacon reads modern. Suggest short subheads: Flux = "Prototype and iterate", Ramp = "Sustained growth", Beacon = "Enterprise control & SLA". Keep 5-7 words each.
Ben: For the calculator CTA variants let's test wording: Variant 1: 'Estimate & Join Webinar' (auto-enroll mid-tier), Variant 2: 'Get a Quote' (opens form), Variant 3: 'Start Trial' (self-serve). We'll A/B these.
Sora: Routing nuance: if a user chooses 'Get a Quote' and commit < $3k, we still show a short form but route to SDR-Lite (faster response but lower priority). Add hidden params: ?sim=slider&val=XXXX&plan=Beacon to pass into CRM.
Tao: Small accessibility note 10 ensure slider is keyboard controllable and the numeric input stays in sync. Also vendor QA for mobile where slider becomes +/- buttons.
LegalBot: Reminder 10 any mention of SLA or reserved capacity must include "subject to standard terms" and a link. Also avoid absolute uptime claims in marketing copy. I can drop boilerplate.
OpsBot: For event exports to BI: create two segments: pricing_slider_touch and pricing_commit_bucket where bucket = ['low','mid','high'] mapping to <1k, 1k-5k, >5k. We'll also record CTA_variant.
Ravi: Webinar tie-in: auto-enroll users with commit between $500 and $4k in the next onboarding webinar; those >4k should be offered a 15-min "walkthrough" slot. Kayla, can the enrollment checkbox be default off? We want explicit opt-in.
Kayla: Default off, but place microcopy: "Enroll in a 30-min product walkthru" with a small link to schedule a time if they prefer calendar booking.
Ben: Experiment hypothesis: variant 'Estimate & Join Webinar' will lift early education conversion and reduce support tickets by 8% in first 30 days. We'll monitor support ticket rate after launch.
Sora: Ops question: do we capture email before enrolling in the webinar? If not, we can't actually enroll them. I suggest: when they click 'Estimate & Join Webinar' open a 1-field modal for email (prefill if logged in) then enroll.
Ravi: Agreed. Minimal friction. Jules from sales had asked for an optional 'we're evaluating enterprise controls' checkbox — show only for buckets > $1.5k.
Kayla: UI detail noted. We'll surface checkbox inline rather than forcing a modal.
Tao: Also add a small log line when user interacts: console.info('pricing_slider', val) to help debug GA events in staging.
Ben: Can we add a short success toast when they submit 'Get a Quote' showing their estimate and a summary of next steps? Small UX win.
LegalBot: I'll paste the terms snippet into the help doc and provide the exact phrasing: "Dedicated commitments and SLAs are subject to our standard terms and contractual agreement." Use that whenever referencing SLA.
Ravi: Action items:
- Kayla: implement slider UI + mobile fallback + tooltip copy (due Fri)
- Sora: define routing buckets & CRM hidden params (due Thu)
- Ben: set up analytics GTM payloads + BI segments (due Thu)
- Tao: accessibility QA plan + staging console logs (due Thu)
- LegalBot: terms snippet and compliant copy (due Thu)
- OpsBot: webinar enrollment flow spec (due Thu)
Sora: I'll also add a short tracking ticket linking to the analytics doc.
Kayla: Will place Figma frames in 'pricing/slider-experiment' and tag the team.
Ravi: Freeze for design/copy = next Mon EOD. If we slip, we push the launch by one sprint. Everyone OK?
Ben: Ok on timing.
Tao: Ok.
